legal_ref: Ustawa z dnia 11 marca 2004 r. o podatku od towarów i usług, art. 146ef ust. 1 pkt 1 read with art. 41 ust. 1 (tekst jednolity Dz. U. 2026 poz. 1263); originally art. 146a (in force from 1 January 2011)
quote: Art. 146ef. 1. W okresie od dnia 1 stycznia 2024 r. do końca roku, w którym suma wydatków wymienionych w art. 40 ust. 1 pkt 2 ustawy z dnia 11 marca 2022 r. o obronie Ojczyzny ... jest wyższa niż 3 % wartości produktu krajowego brutto ...: 1) stawka podatku, o której mowa w art. 41 ust. 1 i 13, art. 109 ust. 2, art. 110, art. 120 ust. 3a i art. 138i ust. 4, wynosi 23 %; 2) stawka podatku, o której mowa w art. 41 ust. 2 ... wynosi 8 % — From 1 Jan 2024 until the end of the year in which the specified defence spending exceeds 3% of GDP, the standard rate (base rate 22% in art. 41(1)) is 23% and the reduced rate (base 7%) is 8%.
source_title: Dziennik Ustaw 2026 poz. 1263 – Obwieszczenie Marszałka Sejmu z 1 września 2026 r., consolidated VAT Act (state of law 26 Aug 2026); 2011 start date from Dz. U. 2011 nr 177 poz. 1054, art. 146a ('W okresie od dnia 1 stycznia 2011 r. do dnia 31 grudnia 2013 r. ... wynosi 23%') https://api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2011/1054/text.pdf

reduced_rates.scope: Annex 3 goods and services, e.g. certain foods and drinks, restaurant and catering services, water supply, medical devices, passenger transport, hotel accommodation, cultural and sports admissions, social housing construction and renovation
Annex 10 goods and services, e.g. basic foodstuffs, books and periodicals incl. e-publications, children's car seats, certain sanitary products
exports, intra-EU supplies, international transport and certain other listed supplies

notes: Art. 41(1) still states a 22% base rate, but a 'temporary' provision has applied 23% since 1 Jan 2011: art. 146a (2011–2013), extended several times, and art. 146ef from 1 Jan 2024. Under art. 146ef the 23%/8% rates end at the end of the year in which the defence spending defined in art. 40(1)(2) of the Homeland Defence Act exceeds 3% of GDP. The Minister of Finance must announce that end date in Monitor Polski by 31 October of that year (art. 146ef(2)). On a reversion, 22%/7% would apply. No such announcement was found, and TEDB (2026-07-01) shows 23% / 8% / 5%.
unverified: No Monitor Polski announcement under art. 146ef ust. 2 was found (Sejm ELI API title search "koniec okresu obowiązywania stawek" returned 0 results on 2026-10-07). The deadline for a 2026 announcement is 31 Oct 2026; if one is made, the standard rate returns to 22% from 1 Jan 2027.
Annex 3 and Annex 10 scope summaries are abbreviated and were not checked item by item
